entry.en: Your passport must expire at least 6 months after arrival and have one blank page for an entry stamp.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe caducar al menos 6 meses después de la llegada y tener una página en blanco para el sello de entrada.
entry.quote: To enter the Marshall Islands, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and one blank page for an entry stamp.

entry.en: British citizens with an onward or return ticket do not need a visa for the Marshall Islands for up to 90 days.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos británicos con billete de continuación o regreso no necesitan visado para las Islas Marshall hasta 90 días.
entry.quote: British citizen passport holders with an onward or return ticket do not require a visa to enter the Marshall Islands for up to 90 days.

entry.en: You must pay a departure tax of 20 US dollars in cash at the airport.
entry.es: Debes pagar una tasa de salida de 20 dólares estadounidenses en efectivo en el aeropuerto.
entry.quote: You must pay a departure tax of 20 US dollars in cash at the airport.

entry.en: You must show proof that children aged 4 and under have had the MMR vaccine.
entry.es: Debes mostrar prueba de que los niños de 4 años o menos han recibido la vacuna triple vírica (SRP).
entry.quote: To enter the Marshall Islands, you must show proof children aged 4 and under have had the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine.

entry.en: You must declare cash in any currency worth more than 10,000 US dollars.
entry.es: Debes declarar el efectivo en cualquier moneda por valor superior a 10.000 dólares estadounidenses.
entry.quote: You must declare cash in any currency worth more than 10,000 US dollars.

entry.en: If you travel through a US territory to reach the Marshall Islands, you must apply for an ESTA.
entry.es: Si viajas a las Islas Marshall a través de un territorio de EE. UU., debes solicitar una ESTA.
entry.quote: If you’re travelling through a US territory to reach the Marshall Islands, you must apply for an Electronic System for Travel Authorisation (ESTA).

safety.en: Crime rates are low, but there is a risk of petty crime, including break-ins and non-violent theft.
safety.es: Los índices de delincuencia son bajos, pero hay riesgo de delitos menores, incluidos robos en domicilios y hurtos sin violencia.
safety.quote: Crime rates are low in the Marshall Islands, but there is a risk of petty crime, including break-ins and non-violent theft.

safety.en: Cyclone season is normally from November to April, but cyclones can happen throughout the year.
safety.es: La temporada de ciclones suele ser de noviembre a abril, pero pueden ocurrir durante todo el año.
safety.quote: Cyclone season is normally from November to April, but cyclones can happen throughout the year.

safety.en: There are severe penalties for all drug offences, including long prison sentences and heavy fines.
safety.es: Hay penas severas para todos los delitos de drogas, incluidas largas condenas de prisión y fuertes multas.
safety.quote: There are severe penalties for all drug offences, including long prison sentences and heavy fines.

safety.en: Wikivoyage says to beware of storm surges and high tides, and that flooding is common due to rising sea level.
safety.es: Wikivoyage advierte de las mareas de tempestad y las mareas altas, y dice que las inundaciones son comunes por la subida del nivel del mar.
safety.quote: Beware of storm surges or high tides. Flooding is common due to rising sea level.

safety.en: There is no recent history of terrorism in the Marshall Islands, but attacks cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No hay antecedentes recientes de terrorismo en las Islas Marshall, pero no se pueden descartar atentados.
safety.quote: Although there’s no recent history of terrorism in the Marshall Islands, attacks cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: Wear a life jacket for canoeing, kayaking or fishing.
safety.es: Usa chaleco salvavidas para practicar piragüismo, kayak o pesca.
safety.quote: Wear a life jacket for canoeing, kayaking or fishing.

health.en: Medical facilities are very limited, so make sure you have comprehensive travel insurance covering all medical costs, including evacuation.
health.es: Las instalaciones médicas son muy limitadas, así que asegúrate de tener un seguro de viaje completo que cubra todos los costes médicos, incluida la evacuación.
health.quote: Medical facilities are very limited. Make sure you have comprehensive travel insurance which covers all medical costs, including medical evacuation.

health.en: Wikivoyage says tap water is not drinkable and recommends bottled water even for brushing your teeth.
health.es: Wikivoyage dice que el agua del grifo no es potable y recomienda agua embotellada incluso para cepillarse los dientes.
health.quote: Tap water is not drinkable. It's recommended to use bottled water even for brushing your teeth.

health.en: Bring sufficient supplies of prescription medicines with you.
health.quote: Bring sufficient supplies of prescription medicines with you.

help.en: The ambulance number is 625 4142 and the police number is 625 8666.
help.es: El número de ambulancias es 625 4142 y el de la policía es 625 8666.

help.en: You can call FCDO in London for urgent help if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Puedes llamar al FCDO en Londres para pedir ayuda urgente si algo le ha pasado a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: The international airport is Majuro International Airport (MAJ).
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional es el Aeropuerto Internacional de Majuro (MAJ).
getting_in.quote: International airports: Majuro International Airport (MAJ IATA).

getting_in.en: Flights are available between Honolulu and the Marshall Islands and to Fiji via Kiribati and Tuvalu.
getting_in.es: Hay vuelos entre Honolulú y las Islas Marshall y a Fiyi vía Kiribati y Tuvalu.
getting_in.quote: Flights are available between Honolulu and the Marshall Islands and to Fiji via Kiribati and Tuvalu.

getting_in.en: United Airlines stops in Majuro and Kwajalein on its island-hopper service between Guam and Honolulu.
getting_in.es: United Airlines hace escala en Majuro y Kwajalein en su servicio island-hopper entre Guam y Honolulú.
getting_in.quote: United Airlines stops in Majuro and Kwajalein on its island-hopper service between Guam and Honolulu.

getting_in.en: Taxis and hotel transport run from the airport to the town.
getting_in.es: Hay taxis y transporte de hotel del aeropuerto a la ciudad.
getting_in.quote: There are taxis and hotel transport from the airport to the town.

getting_around.en: Air Marshall Islands flies between the islands but has financial and technical problems, and its planes are often grounded.
getting_around.es: Air Marshall Islands vuela entre las islas pero tiene problemas financieros y técnicos, y sus aviones suelen quedar en tierra.
getting_around.quote: Air travel between the islands is provided by Air Marshall Islands. However, the company is fraught with financial and technical problems, and one or both of the two planes in the fleet are often grounded for days, weeks or months at a time.

getting_around.en: Field trip ships travel throughout the islands and usually carry passengers as well.
getting_around.es: Los barcos de campo recorren las islas y por lo general también transportan pasajeros.
getting_around.quote: Field trip ships travel throughout the islands, typically to pick up copra and deliver supplies; they usually provide passenger service as well.

getting_around.en: The journey from Majuro to Jaluit is approximately 40 minutes by plane and 24 hours by boat.
getting_around.es: El trayecto de Majuro a Jaluit dura aproximadamente 40 minutos en avión y 24 horas en barco.
getting_around.quote: To give a sense of scale, the journey from Majuro to Jaluit is approximately 40 minutes by plane and 24 hours by boat.

getting_around.en: Taxis are plentiful on Majuro's main road, and anywhere in the Majuro city area costs no more than seventy-five cents.
getting_around.es: Hay muchos taxis en la carretera principal de Majuro, y cualquier trayecto en la ciudad cuesta no más de setenta y cinco centavos.
getting_around.quote: There is a plethora of taxis available on the main road that travels the length of Majuro Atoll, and anywhere in the Majuro city area will cost no more than seventy-five cents.

getting_around.en: A bus to Laura, at the other end of the island, leaves about once an hour from Robert Reimers Hotel.
getting_around.es: Un autobús a Laura, en el otro extremo de la isla, sale aproximadamente cada hora del Robert Reimers Hotel.
getting_around.quote: To get to Laura, on the other end of the island, there is a bus that leaves about once an hour from Robert Reimers Hotel.

money.en: The Marshall Islands use the US dollar (USD).
money.es: Las Islas Marshall usan el dólar estadounidense (USD).
money.quote: The Marshall Islands use the U.S. dollar ("$", ISO currency code: USD).

connectivity.en: A UK mobile phone will not work in the Marshall Islands and international roaming is not available.
connectivity.es: Un móvil del Reino Unido no funcionará en las Islas Marshall y no hay itinerancia internacional.
connectivity.quote: Your UK mobile phone will not work in the Marshall Islands. International roaming is not available.

connectivity.en: Mobile phone service is available from the National Telecommunications Authority.
connectivity.es: El servicio de telefonía móvil lo ofrece la Autoridad Nacional de Telecomunicaciones.
connectivity.quote: Mobile phone service is available from the National Telecommunications Authority.

connectivity.en: One wifi option is a card giving time-limited connection, $5 for 50 minutes.
connectivity.es: Una opción de wifi es una tarjeta de conexión por tiempo limitado, 5 $ por 50 minutos.
connectivity.quote: Buy a card which will give time limited connection - $5 for 50 minutes.
